messages.summary.loaded: Loaded: {name} - {axes} active axes (X-C) - Motor6: {motor6} - {inputs} active inputs - {outputs} active outputs - {fields} fields
messages.legend: Copied = raw value read - Interpreted = display conversion - Unknown = missing/invalid/not mapped. No status confirms a simCNC export.
messages.placeholder.search: Filter tables: field name, value, or note ...
messages.statusbar.ready: {controller} - Source data view - Export not enabled yet
messages.warning.controller_mapping: {subject}: verify hardware channels and plugin configuration before target mapping.
messages.warning.active_missing_port_pin: {subject}: active, but port/pin is missing or 0.
messages.warning.duplicate_field: {subject}: present more than once; no clear import.
messages.warning.invalid_value: {source}: missing or invalid numeric/bool value. Raw value: {raw}
messages.warning.axis_value_missing: {axis}: {field} is missing, invalid, or not positive.
messages.check.help: Load both files → review Mapping / Preview → check configuration. An existing simCNC configuration can be used as reference; nothing is written yet.
messages.check.title: Check completed
messages.check.result: Check result: {ok} OK · {errors} errors · {pending} open items. See Status / Warnings for details.
messages.check.axis_missing: {axis}: Activation field is missing or invalid.
messages.check.axis_bad: {axis}: Active axis – missing or non-positive tuning values: {fields}.
messages.check.axis_ok: {axis}: Active axis – velocity, acceleration and steps are present and positive (raw values).
messages.check.limits: {axis}: Lower limit {lo}, upper limit {hi}; lower must be smaller. Check activation and units separately.
messages.check.io: {signal}: Port={port}, Pin={pin}. Both must be present and positive for this source check; hardware assignment is not confirmed.
messages.check.shared: {signals}: Shared port/pin – check whether sharing is intended.
messages.check.reference_ok: simCNC reference read: {count} XML values. This does not confirm compatibility with the selected controller.
messages.check.reference_missing: No simCNC reference loaded. Select a suitable template using Load simCNC reference.
messages.check.export_pending: Mapping preview shows target paths and provisional values. Open mappings and units need confirmation; the file exporter is not implemented yet.
messages.preview.summary: Mapping: {candidates} provisional values, {pending} open fields. See Mapping / Preview.
messages.preview.reason.unmapped: No confirmed rule yet; no change planned.
messages.preview.reason.axis_binding: AxisToMotor binding missing/ambiguous or auxiliary motor. No target axis inferred.
messages.preview.reason.kit_binding: No unique MotionKit binding found in the reference.
messages.preview.reason.boolean: 0/1 → false/true; target follows AxisToMotor. Confirm axis binding before applying.
messages.preview.reason.units: Provisionally 1:1 with identical units/scaling. Conversion is unconfirmed; not exportable yet.
messages.preview.reason.direction: Target found; polarity and machine direction are not automatically equivalent.
messages.preview.reason.polarity: Boolean proposal; confirm step polarity for the selected controller.
messages.preview.reason.analog: IP-A: review analog/encoder configuration; no step/dir or tuning value proposed.
messages.preview.reason.homing: Target found; RefSpeed needs confirmed conversion to target speed.
messages.preview.reason.gear: Target found; pulley/gear indexing must be confirmed.
messages.preview.reason.io: Assign signal role and CSMIO module/channel manually. MACH3 pin is not copied as simCNC pin.
messages.preview.reason.spindle: Spindle mode, gear/relay mapping and scaling remain open.
messages.preview.reason.reference: Reference missing; target path not verified. No change planned.
messages.preview.reason.target_missing: Target path missing in reference; no value will be inserted.
messages.preview.reason.target_duplicate: Duplicate target path; mapping is ambiguous.
messages.preview.reason.invalid: Source value missing, invalid or duplicated.
messages.preview.reason.conflict: Multiple source values claim the same target. Proposals blocked.
messages.overview.help: See where each MACH3 axis would go in simCNC. Select an axis to compare its values below. All mappings are proposals; nothing is written.
messages.overview.values: Value comparison · * provisional, units need review
